verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Ki Blast Cannon — Ki Blast Super.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Ki Blast Cannon as a Ki Blast Super using a shockwave with knockback/restand behavior.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current independent GameFAQs documentation identifies the Skill Shop as the acquisition route. An older Xenoverse reference instead lists training with Gohan & Videl; this historical discrepancy is retained rather than silently discarded.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The documented acquisition routes are training/shop routes rather than a PQ reward condition, but no explicit negative-UF evidence was found, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage is not promoted as canonical because the current reference does not establish a stable versioned value.

records.name: Ki Blast Cannon
records.character_source: Gohan (Adult), Goku (Super Saiyan God), and customizable partners
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop; older reference lists training with Gohan & Videl
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop / Gohan & Videl training (source conflict retained)
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast shockwave Super that can stagger a juggled or knocked-down opponent and knock back a standing opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 reference describes a yellow shockwave fired from the palm. It can stagger a juggled or knocked-down opponent; against a standing opponent it instead knocks them back. The move can be repeated immediately at no additional cost, with the second hit producing different spacing depending on the opponent's state. The reference also notes a restand property useful for combo resets.
records.combo_notes: Current reference material describes the move as reasonably fast and useful mid-combo, particularly for restand and combo-reset situations.
